title: Drake Hires Bryan Cranston and Aaron Paul from "Breaking Bad" to Work as Bartenders at His Birthday Party
htmlContent:
In a truly epic birthday celebration, Canadian rapper Drake hired Aaron Paul and Bryan Cranston, the stars of the hit AMC show "Breaking Bad," to work as bartenders at his 37th birthday party on October 24, 2023, at Casadonna in Miami, Florida.

The two actors, who played meth-cooking duo Walter White and Jesse Pinkman on the show, arrived at the party in floral shirts and immediately got to work behind the bar, mixing up drinks for Drake's celebrity guests.

In a video shared by TMZ, Paul can be heard telling one customer that a Negroni is "the easiest drink to make," as he pours equal parts gin, vermouth, and Campari into a shaker.

Cranston and Paul also took the time to pose for photos with guests and chat with them, making the party even more unforgettable for everyone in attendance.

It's unclear how Drake managed to convince such big-name stars to bartend at his party, but it's certainly a testament to his popularity and connections.

Drake's decision to hire Cranston and Paul is also a clever way to promote their new mezcal brand, Dos Hombres. The two actors have been promoting the brand heavily in recent months, and their appearance at Drake's party is sure to generate even more buzz.

Overall, Drake's birthday party was a night to remember, and the fact that he had Bryan Cranston and Aaron Paul bartending for him makes it even more special. It's just one more example of how Drake always looks for ways to make his events unique and unforgettable.
